source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 21 exercise solved (PDF 184-185): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short, long and inquisitive questions, Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 21 (Immunity) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb aur kitab ke numbers ke saath (MCQs 1-10, short 1-7, long 1-9, inquisitive 1-4). Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Which of these are known for stimulating an immune response?
(In mein se kaun immune response (difaai rad-e-amal) ko ubharte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Antigens woh ghair (foreign) molecules hain (maslan jaraseem ki satah par) jinhein T aur B cells pehchante hain aur jo khaas antibodies banwate hain (21.3). Antibodies response ka nateeja hain, us ki wajah nahi.

blocks.prompt:
2. Which of the following is a part of the innate immune system?
(In mein se kaun innate (paidaishi) immune system ka hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Innate (paidaishi) immunity paidaish se maujood ghair makhsoos (non-specific) difa hai: pehli line (jild, nizam-e-hazam aur saans ki nalein) aur doosri line. T cells, B cells aur antibodies acquired (makhsoos) immunity ka hissa hain (21.1, 21.3).

blocks.prompt:
3. Which of these is not involved in body’s non-specific defence?
(In mein se kaun jism ke non-specific difa mein shamil nahi?)
blocks.explanation: NK cells, complement system aur inflammation doosri (non-specific) difaai line ka hissa hain; antibodies teesri makhsoos line mein B cells banate hain (21.2, 21.3).

blocks.prompt:
4. Skin offers an impenetrable barrier to microbes. It is categorized as;
(Jild jaraseem ke liye na-qabil-e-guzar deewar hai. Ise kis qism mein rakha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jild pehli difaai line ka hissa hai jo tamam jaraseem ke khilaf ek jaisa kaam karti hai, is liye yeh non-specific difa hai (21.1, 21.2).

blocks.prompt:
5. What is the difference between B cells and T cells?
(B cells aur T cells mein kya farq hai?)

options.text: B cells antibodies banate hain aur T cells infected cells tabah karte hain
B cells aur T cells ek hi kaam karte hain
B cells jaraseem par seedha hamla karte hain aur T cells antibodies banate hain
B cells jism ki raqiq cheezon mein aur T cells cells ke andar kaam karte hain

blocks.explanation: B cells se plasma cells bante hain jo antibodies chhorte hain (antibody-mediated immunity); cytotoxic T cells infected ya cancer cells ko pehchan kar tabah karte hain (cell-mediated immunity) (21.3.2). T cells infected cells par bahar se hamla karte hain, andar nahi, is liye (d) durust nahi.

blocks.prompt:
6. How do the neutrophils kill microbes?
(Neutrophils jaraseem ko kaise marte hain?)

options.text: Cells tak oxygen le ja kar

blocks.explanation: Neutrophils jaraseem ko phagocytosis (nigal kar hazam karna), jaraseem-kush chemicals chhor kar aur DNA fibres ka jaal chhor kar marte hain (21.2.1). Options mein sirf (a) durust hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. Which group of chemicals is involved in inflammatory response?
(Inflammatory response (soozish) mein kaun se chemicals shamil hain?)
blocks.explanation: Infected ya zakhmi cells histamines aur prostaglandins chhorte hain jo khoon ki naliyan khol dete aur capillaries ko rasne wala banate hain: surkhi, sojan aur garmi (21.2.3). Pyrogens bukhar karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
8. Which type of white blood cell is responsible for producing antibodies?
(Kaun sa safaid khooni khaliya (WBC) antibodies banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Apne antigen se milne par B cell taqseem ho kar plasma cells banata hai jo antibodies chhorte hain (21.3.1, 21.3.2).

blocks.prompt:
9. What types of drug are not prescribed to a recipient of organ-transplantation?
(Organ transplant lene wale ko kis qism ki dawa nahi di jati?)
blocks.explanation: Mareez ke T aur B cells naye organ par hamla kar sakte hain, is liye doctor immunity dabane wali dawaein dete hain; immunity barhane wali dawaein rejection (radd) ko barhayengi (21.3.3).

blocks.prompt:
10. Cell-mediated immunity works best against;
(Cell-mediated immunity sab se behtar kis ke khilaf kaam karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cell-mediated immunity cytotoxic T cells ke zariye virus-infected aur ghair maamooli (cancer) cells ko marti hai. Zehrile molecules ko antibodies (antibody-mediated immunity) be-asar karte hain (21.3.2).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (a) mein "Viruses infected cells" chhapa hai; durust "Virus-infected cells" hai (jaise option (c) mein).

blocks.prompt:
1. Define the roles of the different types of T cells.
T cells ki mukhtalif qismon ke kaam bataein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Helper T cells: immune response shuru karte hain; cell-mediated aur antibody-mediated immunity ko chalate hain.
2. Cytotoxic T cells: jaraseem se infected cells aur cancer cells ko tor (maar) dete hain.
3. Inducer T cells: thymus mein T cells ki nashonuma (pukhtagi) ki nigrani karte hain.
4. Suppressor T cells: immune response khatam (band) karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
2. Skin is an important component of our defence system. Comment.
Jild hamare difaai nizam ka ahem hissa hai. Tabsira karein.
blocks.explanation: Jild pehli difaai line hai. Is ka epidermis 10-30 cells mota hai; bahar ki stratum corneum ke cells sakht keratin se bhare hote hain aur musalsal jharte aur naye bante hain, is tarah na-qabil-e-guzar deewar banti hai. Tel aur paseene ke ghadood satah ka pH 3-5 kar dete hain jo jaraseem ki nashonuma rokta hai, aur paseene mein lysozyme hai jo bacteria ki cell wall hazam karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. State how the digestive and respiratory tracts play a role in body’s defence.
Nizam-e-hazam aur saans ki nalein jism ke difa mein kya kirdar ada karti hain?
blocks.explanation:
Nizam-e-hazam: thook (saliva) ka lysozyme khane ke bohat se bacteria marta hai; maide ka tez tezab aur aanton ke protein hazam karne wale enzymes mazeed bacteria marte hain.
Saans ki nalein: naak ki cilia wali epithelium bacteria rokti hai; bronchi aur bronchioles ke cells chipchipa mucus chhorte hain jo jaraseem pakarta hai, aur cilia mucus ko upar dhakel dete hain jahan woh nigla jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. How the natural killer cells play role in body’s defence?
Natural killer cells jism ke difa mein kya kirdar ada karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Natural killer cells doosri difaai line ke jaraseem-kush lymphocytes hain. Yeh jaraseem par hamla nahi karte; virus se infected jism ke cells pehchan kar perforins chhorte hain jo target cell ki membrane mein surakh banate hain; pani andar ghus kar cell phool kar phat jata hai. Yeh cancer cells ko bhi tumour banne se pehle pehchan kar maar dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
5. Define pyrogens and state their effect of hypothalamus.
Pyrogens ki tareef karein aur hypothalamus par un ka asar bataein.
blocks.explanation: Pyrogens woh chemicals hain jo macrophages jaraseem par hamle ke waqt chhorte hain. Yeh khoon ke zariye hypothalamus (jism ka thermostat) tak ja kar use jism ka andaruni temperature 37°C se upar le jane par uksate hain; bukhar hota hai jo jaraseem ki afzaish rokta aur neutrophils aur macrophages ko tez karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "effect of hypothalamus" chhapa hai; durust "effect on hypothalamus" (hypothalamus par asar) hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. What do you mean by autoimmune diseases?
Autoimmune bimariyon se kya murad hai?
blocks.explanation: Autoimmune bimariyan tab hoti hain jab immune system jism ke apne cells aur ghair maadde mein farq nahi kar pata aur apne hi cells aur tissues par hamla kar ke unhein tabah karta hai. Misalein: myasthenia gravis, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), rheumatoid arthritis aur type I diabetes.
Antigen rad-e-amal ubharta hai; antibody us ke khilaf bana protein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. Describe the role of macrophages and neutrophils in killing bacteria.
Bacteria marne mein macrophages aur neutrophils ka kirdar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Macrophages aur neutrophils khoon ke jaraseem-kush cells hain, non-specific doosri difaai line ka sab se ahem hissa; yeh khoon mein gasht karte aur hamla awaron par toot parte hain.
Macrophages:
1. Monocytes (WBCs) se bante hain jo tissues mein jate hain.
2. Bacterium ko endocytosis (phagocytosis) se nigal kar lysozyme enzymes se marte hain.
3. Kuch organs (phephre, jigar, tilli, dimagh) mein muqeem; zyada tar khoon, lymph aur interstitial fluid mein gasht.
4. Soozish mein us jagah pohanch kar jaraseem nigalte aur mare jaraseem, cells aur malba saaf karte hain.
5. Pyrogens chhorte hain (bukhar) aur aise proteins banate hain jo helper T cells jagate hain, yani makhsoos immunity se rabta.
6. Antibody lage antigens ko tabah karte hain.
Neutrophils (WBC ki qism) teen tareeqon se jaraseem marte hain:
1. Phagocytosis: nigal kar hazam karna.
2. Jaraseem par ghulne wale jaraseem-kush chemicals chhorna.
3. DNA fibres ka jaal chhorna jo bacteria ko jakar kar marta hai.
Soozish wali jagah bari tadaad mein jate hain; mare neutrophils, tissue cells aur jaraseem mil kar peep (pus) banate hain.
Yeh cells jism ke apne cells par hamla nahi karte kyun ke un par self-proteins hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain how the proteins of the complement system kill bacteria and how the interferons inhibit the ability of viruses to infect cells.
Complement system ke proteins bacteria ko kaise marte hain aur interferons viruses ko cells infect karne se kaise rokte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Complement system:
1. Darjan se zyada mukhtalif proteins jo jigar mein bante aur khoon mein ghair faal halat mein gardish karte hain.
2. Jaraseem se milte hi silsilewar faal hote hain: pehla doosre ko jagata hai, wagaira (cascade).
3. Aakhri paanch proteins jaraseem ki plasma membrane mein membrane-attack complex (MAC) banate hain.
4. MAC membrane mein surakh karta hai; raqiq aur namkiyat andar jate hain, jaraseem phool kar phat jata hai.
5. Antigen se jure kuch antibodies bhi complement jagate hain (antibody-mediated immunity mein).
Interferons:
1. Virus-infected cells ke chhore hue hifazati proteins; cytokines ki qism jo cells ke darmiyan paigham le jate hain.
2. Paas ke cells tak ja kar un ka anti-viral difa barhate hain, is liye virus unhein asaani se infect nahi kar sakta.
3. Doosre immune cells jaise natural killer cells aur macrophages ko jagate hain jo infected cells tabah karte hain.
4. Bukhar ke dauran zyada interferons chhore jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. Inflammation is one of the most generalized nonspecific defences. How?
Inflammation (soozish) sab se aam non-specific difa kaise hai?
blocks.explanation:
Inflammation kisi bhi infection ya zakhm ka aam jawab hai, jaraseem koi bhi ho:
1. Infected ya zakhmi cells chemical ishare chhorte hain: histamines aur prostaglandins.
2. Yeh us jagah khoon ki naliyan khol dete hain, capillaries mein khoon ka bahao barhta hai.
3. Capillaries zyada rasne wali ho jati hain, raqiq bahar aata hai: surkhi, sojan aur garmi (soozish).
4. Garmi jagah ko jaraseem ke liye na-munasib banati, zakhm bharti aur WBCs ki harkat barhati hai.
5. Zyada phagocytes (macrophages aur neutrophils) khoon se soozish wali jagah ja kar jaraseem nigalte hain.
6. Monocytes aa kar jaraseem-kush chemicals chhorte hain; phir macrophages mare jaraseem, cells aur malba saaf karte hain (peep = mare neutrophils, toote tissue cells aur mare jaraseem).
Chun ke yeh har nuqsan par shuru hoti, har qism ke jaraseem ke khilaf foran kaam karti aur aksar un ka phailao rok deti hai, is liye yeh sab se aam non-specific difa hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. How are monocytes, T-cells and B-cells the components of the immune system?
Monocytes, T-cells aur B-cells immune system ke ajza kaise hain?
blocks.explanation:
Immune system ek jagah nahi; yeh WBCs se bana hai jo bone marrow mein bante, khoon aur lymph mein gardish karte, aur lymph nodes, tilli, jigar, thymus aur bone marrow mein milte hain. Is ki teen bari qismein monocytes, T cells aur B cells hain (T aur B cells lymphocytes hain).
1. Monocytes: lymphoid tissues mein bane WBCs; interstitial fluid mein ja kar macrophages bante hain jo jaraseem nigalte aur helper T cells jagane wale proteins banate hain. Kuch jigar, tilli aur lymph nodes mein phagocytes ban kar malba saaf aur tissue ki marammat karte hain.
2. T cells: bone marrow ke stem cells se bante aur thymus mein pak kar antigens pehchanna seekhte hain; karoron qismein, har ek ek antigen pehchanta hai. Chaar qismein: helper (response shuru), cytotoxic (infected cells marna), inducer (T cells ki nashonuma ki nigrani), suppressor (response khatam). Yeh cell-mediated immunity chalate hain.
3. B cells: bone marrow mein bante aur pakte, phir khoon aur lymph mein gardish; har ek khaas antigen pehchanta hai. Us se milne par plasma cells banta hai jo antibodies chhor kar antigen par tabahi ka nishan lagate hain (antibody-mediated immunity); kuch memory B cells bante hain.
Mil kar yeh makhsoos hamla awaron ko pehchante, tabah karte aur yaad rakhte hain, is liye makhsoos teesri difaai line banate hain.

blocks.prompt:
5. Differentiate the two types of acquired immunity (active and passive immunity).
Acquired immunity ki do qismon (active aur passive immunity) mein farq karein.
blocks.explanation: Acquired (makhsoos) immunity nashonuma ke dauran banti hai aur do qism ki hai. Active immunity mein jism khud antigens ke khilaf antibodies banata hai; yeh natural (qudrati tor par antigens se wasta, sab se moassar) ya artificial (kamzor antigens ki vaccination jo asal ke khilaf antibodies banwati hai) ho sakti hai. Passive immunity mein shakhs ko khaas jaraseem ke khilaf bani banai antibodies di jati hain; yeh thori der ki hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. Describe the roles T-cells in cell-mediated immunity.
Cell-mediated immunity mein T-cells ke kirdar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Jab macrophage jaraseem nigalta hai to khaas proteins banata hai; helper T cells apne receptors se inhein pehchan kar faal ho jate hain. Yeh cell-mediated immunity shuru karte hain jo T cells virus-infected aur cancer cells ke khilaf chalate hain. Waqiat:
1. Proliferation (afzaish): faal helper T cells T cell growth factor banate hain jis se har qism ke T cells barh kar antigen pehchanne wale bare clones bante hain.
2. Activation: helper T cells doosra factor chhorte hain jo macrophages ko infection ki jagah bulata hai.
3. Induction: helper T cells thymus mein inducer T cells jagate hain jo lymphocytes ko T cells mein pakne par uksate hain.
4. Attack (hamla): cytotoxic T cells ke receptors infected cells pehchan kar un se jurte aur un ki membrane mein surakh karte hain; cells phat jate hain (NK cells jaisa tareeqa).
5. Suppression: suppressor T cells aahista barhte hain; 1-2 hafte baad itne ho jate hain ke cytotoxic response band kar dete hain.
6. Memory: helper aur cytotoxic T cells ki ek abadi (memory cells) shayad umar bhar rehti hai aur wahi jaraseem dobara aaye to foran jawab deti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "the roles T-cells" chhapa hai; durust "the roles of T-cells" hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. Describe the role of B-cells in antibody-mediated immunity.
Antibody-mediated immunity mein B-cells ka kirdar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Faal helper T cells antibody-mediated (humoral) immunity bhi shuru karte hain jo doosra, zyada mazboot difa hai. B cells antigens par seedha hamla nahi karte; un par tabahi ka nishan lagate aur zehrile molecules be-asar karte hain. Waqiat:
1. Proliferation: har B cell apni satah ke B receptor proteins se antigen pakarta hai; helper T cells in B cells se jur kar aise proteins chhorte hain jin se yeh taqseem ho kar bohat se plasma cells bante hain.
2. Differentiation aur secretion: plasma cells taqseem band kar ke zyada B receptor proteins banate hain jo antibodies ki shakal mein chhore jate hain; chand dinon mein bohat bari tadaad.
3. Attack: antibodies teen tareeqon se tabahi ka nishan lagati hain: (i) complement: complement proteins jaga kar antigen cell mein surakh, cell phool kar phat'ta hai; (ii) macrophages antibody lage antigen ko pehchan kar nigalte aur torte hain; (iii) killer cells jin ke receptors antibody lage antigen pehchan kar use marte hain.
4. Suppression: kai hafton baad suppressor T cells antibody response band kar dete hain.
5. Memory: clone ke kuch cells memory B cells ban kar rehte hain aur wahi antigen dobara aaye to tez secondary response dete hain; vaccines isi tarah memory cells banati hain.
Antibody ki banawat: Y-shakal, do bhari (heavy) aur do halki (light) chains jo disulphide bridges se jurin; variable regions khaas antigen-binding site banate hain.

blocks.prompt:
8. Define allergies. Correlate the symptoms of allergies with the release of histamines.
Allergies ki tareef karein. Allergy ki alamaat ka histamines ke kharij hone se taalluq bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Allergy immune system ki aise kamzor antigens (allergens) ke liye hadd se zyada hassasiyat hai jo aksar logon mein koi rad-e-amal paida nahi karte, maslan gard, phaphoondi, pollen (zarr-e-gul), billi ki khushki, kuch ghizaein aur dawaein (penicillin).
Tareeqa aur alamaat:
1. Allergen se wasta parne par kuch log E-antibodies banate hain.
2. E-antibodies mast cells (khoon ki naliyon ke gird connective tissue mein) se jurti hain.
3. Agli dafa allergen in antibodies se milta hai aur mast cells histamines chhorte hain.
4. Histamines soozish shuru karti hain: naliyan khulne se surkhi aur garmi; capillaries se raqiq rasne se sojan, behti naak aur aankhon se pani; kharish se chheenkein aur khujli (jild par dane).
5. Kuch logon mein bohat zyada histamine se anaphylactic shock, jis mein sojan se saans lena mushkil; jaan leva ho sakta hai.
Is tarah alamaat histamine ka asar hain. Ilaj: antihistamine dawaein histamines rok kar waqti aaram deti hain; desensitization (allergen ke extract ke injections) G-antibodies banata hai jo allergen ko E-antibodies tak pohanchne se pehle khatam kar deti hain.

blocks.prompt:
9. How are T-cells and B-cells related to transplant rejections?
T-cells aur B-cells ka transplant rejection se kya taalluq hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Har shakhs ke cells par self-proteins ka khaas set hota hai, molecular fingerprints jaisa; apne T aur B cells inhein pehchante aur sirf ghair cells par hamla karte hain.
2. Organ transplant mein dene wale (donor) ke organ ke self-proteins lene wale se na milein to masla.
3. Lene wale ke T cells (cytotoxic) naye organ ke cells par hamla karte aur B cells us ke proteins ke khilaf antibodies banate hain. Yeh transplant rejection hai.
Bachao:
1. Aisa donor jis ke self-proteins zyada se zyada milein: jurwan (identical twin, 100%) > behan bhai > walidain > ghair rishtedar (milne ka imkaan taqreeban 1 lakh-2 lakh mein 1).
2. Immunity dabane wali dawaein (jo infections se larne ki taqat bhi kam karti hain).
3. Monoclonal antibodies se transplant par hamla karne wale T cells tabah karna.
4. Stem cells se naya immune system banana jo transplant ko apna samjhe.

blocks.prompt:
1. Rationalize the inflammatory response in arthritis as an example of a misdirected immune response.
Arthritis mein inflammatory response ko ghalat simt mein jane wale immune response ki misaal ke tor par samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Soozish ka maqsad infection ya zakhm se larna hai: chemicals naliyan kholte, phagocytes jama hote aur jaraseem khatam hote hain, phir yeh ruk jati hai. Arthritis mein jorhon mein baghair infection ya zakhm ke soozish hoti hai. Rheumatoid arthritis mein immune system apne aur ghair mein farq nahi kar pata aur jorhon ke cartilage ke khilaf antibodies banata hai (autoimmune bimari). Is se hone wali soozish (sojan, dard, garmi) aur hamla awar cells ke chemicals jaraseem ke bajaye jism ke apne jorhon ko nuqsan pohanchate hain. Yani hifazati rad-e-amal ghalat nishane, khud jism, par chal parta hai: misdirected (ghalat simt) immune response.

blocks.prompt:
2. Justify why the physicians prescribe antipyretic drugs, when fever is a nonspecific defence against microbial infections.
Jab bukhar jaraseem ke khilaf non-specific difa hai to doctor bukhar utarne ki (antipyretic) dawaein kyun dete hain? Jawaz dein.
blocks.explanation: Darmiyana bukhar faida mand hai: macrophages ke pyrogens hypothalamus se temperature barhwate hain jo bacteria aur viruses ki afzaish rokta, garmi se hassas jaraseem marta aur neutrophils, macrophages ko tez karta hai. Magar faide ki had hai. Taqreeban 103°F (39.4°C) se upar temperature khatarnak aur 105°F (40.5°C) se upar aksar jaan leva samjha jata hai, kyun ke zyada garmi jism ke apne cells, enzymes aur dimagh ko nuqsan deti hai. Tez bukhar se takleef, pani ki kami aur kamzori bhi hoti hai (aur chhote bachon mein daure, chapter se aage). Is liye doctor antipyretic dawa de kar temperature mehfooz had mein rakhte aur mareez ko aaram dete hain, jab ke infection ka ilaj doosri dawaon (maslan antibiotics) se hota hai aur immune system kaam karta rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Justify why physicians prescribe antihistamine therapy to the patients of runny nose or skin rashes.
Doctor behti naak ya jild par danon ke mareezon ko antihistamine ilaj kyun dete hain? Jawaz dein.
blocks.explanation: Behti naak aur jild par dane aam tor par allergy ka rad-e-amal hain. Allergy mein mast cells se jurin E-antibodies allergen (gard, pollen, kuch ghizaein, dawaein) se milti hain aur mast cells histamines chhorte hain. Histamines naliyan kholti aur raqiq rasati hain, jis se behti naak, chheenkein, khujli, jild ki surkhi aur sojan (dane) hote hain. Asal masla be-zarar allergen nahi, histamine ka asar hai. Antihistamine dawaein histamines ko rok deti hain, is liye yeh asraat ruk jate hain aur mareez ko (waqti) aaram milta hai. Yeh allergy ka mukammal ilaj nahi; lambe arse ke liye allergen se parhez ya desensitization chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe the discovery of monoclonal antibodies and justify how this accomplishment revolutionized many aspects of biological research.
Monoclonal antibodies ki daryaft bayan karein aur jawaz dein ke is kamyabi ne biological research ke kai pehluon mein inqilab kaise barpa kiya.
blocks.explanation:
Pas-e-manzar: antigen ka sirf chhota hissa, determinant, antibody ki binding site mein fit hota hai. Ek antigen ke mukhtalif determinants se jurne wali antibodies polyclonal hain; sirf ek determinant se jurne wali monoclonal hain.
Daryaft: Cesar Milstein aur George Kohler (Nobel Prize, 1984) ne antibodies banane wale plasma cells ko cancer cells (myelomas) se milaya. Kuch jure hue cells, hybridomas, culture mein barhe aur taqseem hue: plasma cell ke genes se ek khaas antibody aur myeloma ke genes se be-had taqseem. Is tarah tezi se barhne wale hybridoma cells ne ek khalis (monoclonal) antibody bari miqdaar mein banayi.
Inqilab kyun:
1. Ek hi, bohat makhsoos antibody bari miqdaar mein milne lagi; aam plasma cells culture mein taqseem nahi hote, is liye yeh mumkin na tha.
2. Safai (purification): pecheeda mixture se khaas molecules alag aur saaf kiye ja sakte hain; interferon isi tarah saaf hua.
3. Tib: khaas ilaj ko nishane tak le jane wali sawari; research jari hai ke radioactive monoclonal antibodies ko sirf cancer cells wale antigens par bheja jaye taake sirf cancer cells marein.
4. Transplant: transplant par hamla karne wale T cells ko tabah karne ke liye.
5. (Chapter se aage:) bohat se tashkhees ke tests (maslan hamal aur bimariyon ke tests) aur research mein cells aur tissues mein khaas proteins ki pehchan aur jagah maloom karna inhi par mabni hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Hybridoma ko yun samjhein: plasma cell (khaas antibody banane ki salahiyat, magar culture mein taqseem nahi) + myeloma cancer cell (kabhi na rukne wali taqseem, magar antibody nahi) = hybridoma, jo dono khoobiyan rakhta hai: be-had barhta hai aur ek hi khaas antibody banata rehta hai.
